name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Advanced Central Procedural Graph featuring dedicated High-Margin Market Clearing, extended Day 30 Town Shop fulfillment, horizon-gated capital reinvestment, decoupled 10-hand workforce rush, inverted land expansion, dynamic zero-animal feed reserves, and cluster-harvest worker dispatch.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges and immediately fulfills mature high-margin crops (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins, Strawberries) to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums through Day 30.

nodes.name: High-Margin Market Clearing
nodes.description: Routinely liquidates unreserved surplus mature inventory on the open market during cyclical price peaks (current_price >= 1.05 * base_price) under strict 1-2 order slot limits to preserve worker dispatch bandwidth.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing uncommitted low-margin inventory under strict price floors (>= 0.85 * base_price at 92% capacity) while protecting animal feed and shop contracts.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash beyond wage reserves into early workforce acceleration (low-hurdle 10-hand rush), contiguous land expansion (28-30 plots), and horizon-gated commercial seeds.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with cluster harvesting and batch transit: hands fill carrying capacity before shed routing, prioritizing harvesting, watering, feeding, planting, and ground maintenance.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); schedule worker harvest drop-offs at hours 19-20; execute emergency batch liquidation of unreserved, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll before midnight.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop fulfillment.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and ((shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 and day <= 30) or (net_available_cash >= 150.0 and day <= 27))
attributes.guidance: Allocate up to 3 market slots to deliver matching mature shed inventory directly to town shops through Day 30 for 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums; procure shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) only when net cash covers seed costs plus a 1.20x wage buffer and crop maturation horizon allows harvest before Day 30.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase Pumpkin seeds after Day 23, Tomato seeds after Day 25, or Carrot seeds after Day 27; never liquidate produce committed to active town shop contracts on the open market; do not deliver Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3).

attributes.condition: has_surplus_mature_inventory and current_price >= 1.05 * base_price and shed_used > (n_animals * 3)
attributes.guidance: Allocate at most 1 to 2 market order slots per step to sell uncommitted, non-feed mature crops (Wheat, Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) and livestock commodities when market price reaches cyclical premiums (current_price >= 1.05 * base_price); sell commodities with the highest percentage premium first, leaving at least 8 order slots for farm worker execution.
attributes.pitfalls: Never consume more than 2 order slots per step to avoid starving field labor dispatch; never sell inventory committed to active town shop contracts; never liquidate Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3).

attributes.guidance: Evict pending non-urgent buy orders to free order slots; execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings under a strict floor of current_price >= 0.85 * base_price; only relax floor to 0.65 * base_price if shed_used >= 98 to prevent silent 100/100 discard drops.
attributes.pitfalls: Never fire-sell below 0.85 * base_price during transient shed spikes under 98% capacity; never liquidate Wheat below livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); never sell produce reserved for active town shop delivery.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (>= 0.75 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts; never sell Wheat below livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3).

attributes.condition: (hired_hands < 10 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due + 75.0 and day <= 10) or (hired_hands == 10 and uncultivated_plots <= 1 and total_plots < 30 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.25 + 180.0 and day <= 24) or (has_seed_deficit and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.15 + 50.0 and day <= 29)
attributes.guidance: Execute capital reinvestment in three disciplined phases: 1) Rush workforce to 10 hired hands early (Days 1-6) whenever net cash covers payroll plus a $75 buffer; 2) Once 10 hands are active and existing plots are cultivated (uncultivated_plots <= 1), acquire contiguous land plots up to 28-30 total plots through Day 24; 3) Continuously purchase high-margin commercial seeds strictly aligned with maturation cutoffs (cease Pumpkins at Day 23, Tomatoes at Day 25, Carrots at Day 27; plant fast Wheat on Days 28-29). Prohibit fertilizer purchases until 10 hands and 20 plots are established; halt all land and hand purchases after Day 24.
attributes.pitfalls: Never buy land when uncultivated plots exceed 1 or before reaching 10 hands; never purchase fertilizer during early game liquidity scaling; never purchase seeds past their maturation horizon; ensure net cash never breaches the 1.15x midnight wage safety margin.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch active hands with cluster harvesting: workers harvest adjacent mature plots and fill carrying capacity before navigating to the shed. Restrict shed drop-offs to: 1) workers with full carried capacity, 2) pre-midnight liquidity drop-offs (hours 20-21), and 3) terminal cleanup at step 716. Prioritize intermediate tasks: water dry crops immediately to sustain growth cycles; feed livestock; plant commercial seeds; perform weeding and tilling only when no harvesting, watering, or planting tasks remain.
attributes.pitfalls: Never route a worker across the farm to the shed with a single harvested item if adjacent plots have mature crops or dry plots needing water; never leave mature crops unharvested across multi-step windows; avoid pathing bottlenecks around the shed entrance; ensure all carried items are deposited at shed before step 716.
